sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The filter name. You can specify one or more names for the query. Valid values:

- SkillSpaceId: the SkillSpace ID. Exact match.

- SkillSpaceName: the SkillSpace name.

- MatchType: the match type that controls the matching behavior of SkillSpace. Valid values: exact, prefix, and fuzzy.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The list of filter values. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that was returned in the previous API call.
